description: Defines the AlarmCalculatedFieldConfiguration class, which manages alarm-related calculated field configurations including rules, propagation settings, and related methods.

classes.name: AlarmCalculatedFieldConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for alarm calculated fields, including rules, propagation, and evaluation logic.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of calculated field, which is ALARM.

methods.name: getOutput
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no specific output configuration.

methods.name: requiresScheduledReevaluation
methods.description: Determines if the rules require scheduled reevaluation based on contained rules.

methods.name: getAllRules
methods.description: Returns a stream of all rules including create and clear rules, sorted with nulls last.

methods.name: rulesEqual
methods.description: Checks equality of rules between this and another configuration using a custom equality check.

methods.name: propagationSettingsEqual
methods.description: Checks if propagation settings are equal between this and another configuration.
